criteria.pass_when: Answers 300 requests after 60 seconds at 15 req/s, in short text under the revised user preference. Preserves that this is a model and does not install tools, create a decorative visual or claim interaction.
criteria.evidence: Actual response, tool trace and unchanged input inventory.

criteria.pass_when: Provides the small calculation or assumptions needed to assess the answer without a full model report or repeated tool-capability discussion.
criteria.evidence: Semantic reading of the complete user-visible answer, not a word-count threshold.

calibration_pairs.facts: Backlog starts at 0 requests. Over 60 seconds, incoming traffic is a constant 0 to 20 requests/second and service capacity is 10 requests/second. End backlog = max(0, incoming_rate - 10) * 60 requests. This is a deterministic model with no burst or latency estimate.
calibration_pairs.good: The modeled backlog is 300 requests after 60 seconds: (15 − 10) × 60, starting from zero.
calibration_pairs.poor: An output-selection limitation precludes interactive materialization. With a zero-request initialization, the accumulation horizon is 60 seconds. The ingress-service differential is 5 requests per second. The resulting modeled accumulation is 300 requests. The interactive materialization limitation remains in effect.
calibration_pairs.distinction: Both preserve the answer; the poor response obscures it with jargon, repetition and disproportionate detail.
